text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.

WHEAT TENDERS - Jordan will tender on August 12 for 100,000 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter wheat. One shipment of 50,000 tonnes is for October delivery and the rest for November, European traders said.
- Morocco was seeking a total of 120,000 tonnes of optional-origin wheat to be delivered in August and September, European traders said. Offers are due August 4.
WHEAT TENDERS - Iraq is in the world market with a tender for 50,000 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter wheat for August or September, European grain traders said.

- The CCC was seeking up to 6,500 tonnes of U.S. No. 2 or better hard red winter wheat for donation to Armenia and 6,500 tonnes of U.S. HRW wheat for donation to Georgia. Shipment was slated for Aug 20-Sept 8. Offers are due August 5.

Armenia was also seeking 1,000 to 1,500 tonnes of U.S. No. 2 or better HRW wheat in bulk under the PL-480, Title I export program, its U.S. export agent said. Delivery dates were set for Aug 20-Sept 8 and offers were due Aug 5.

VEGOIL TENDERS - Egypt's official Holding Company for Food Industries will seek on August 19, 10,000 to 20,000 tonnes of crude sunflower and/or semi-refined cottonseed oil for delivery in the second half of September.
MARKET TALK - The Turkish government has raised the import tax rate on milling wheat to 45 percent from 35 percent and on durum wheat to 40 percent from 30 percent, the Official Gazette said.
... South Korea bought at least 322,400 tonnes of grains and oilseeds during July through tenders and private negotiations, traders said on Friday.
... India will not impose changed quarantine restrictions on the import of one million tonnes of Australian wheat, Australian officials said on Friday.
... USDA said it released an additional $150 million in short-term GSM-102 export credit guarantees to Mexico.
With the addition, $1.225 billion of the export credits have been offered to facilitate sales of U.S. agricultural products to Mexico in fiscal 1997, which ends September 30.
